companies.notes: 2026 demand: 7 July buyer listing seeks EN590 10 ppm, 50,000 MT for China, CIF or FOB; listed as actively seeking quotes. Its own website describes commodity trading, including EN590. Marketplace verification does not establish a funded principal purchase or award; confirm authority and bank instrument.

2026 demand: 9 June buyer listing requests EN590 10 ppm, 50,000 MT monthly for China, allowing CIF, FOB or TTO; status listed as actively seeking quotes. A separate company profile says it sources overseas goods for Chinese buyers, not that it buys this cargo on its own account. Principal mandate and financing remain unverified; no petroleum-specific company website verified.

2026 demand: 22 August RFQ seeks EN590 10 ppm, 50,000 MT trial per month CIF Rotterdam; proposes 100,000 MT/month later. Status: posted request, not an awarded tender. Identity and principal status unverified: a separate EUROGAS LLC seller listing gives a French location, with no established link to the Dutch poster.

2026 demand: LOI dated 24 July and posted 25 July requests EN590 diesel, 10 ppm sulfur, 30,000 MT every 15 days CIF Izmir or Gebze, Turkey. Status: stated intention/request for seller offer, not a signed supply agreement. Spain is the poster location; corporate registration, buyer mandate and financing were not independently established.

2026 demand: RFQ posted 1 June says “looking for Diesel / EN590 10 ppm”, 50,000 MT × 12 months CIF Ulsan; requests a seller offer before sending LOI. Status: unawarded buyer request. The same text also claims an ability to supply diesel, so own-account buying and corporate identity need independent verification.

companies.notes: 2026 government procurement reporting documents EN590-10 ppm direct imports and identifies Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation as the procuring entity. The separate 25,000–50,000 MT official tender specified approximately 50 ppm gasoil and closed on 3 September 2026. The EN590 purchases were approved direct procurement, not confirmed open RFQs; current open status is not confirmed.
